title: Weekly Portfolio Check-In — August 04, 2026
content:
Hey everyone, it's your boy Ambitriber here, and welcome back to my weekly portfolio update. I'm excited to share with you where I stand as of today, August 4th, 2026. My portfolio is looking pretty stable, with a total value of $47,372.76. I've got a diverse mix of ETFs and individual stocks that I believe have strong potential for growth.

Let's talk about a few of my top holdings. I've got a significant stake in the iShares MSCI ACWI UCITS ETF (IUSQ.DE), which accounts for 18.82% of my portfolio. This ETF gives me broad exposure to the global market, and I believe it's a great way to capture any potential gains from a rising global economy. I'm also holding onto my position in Alibaba-ADR (BABA), which has been a steady performer for me over the past few months. I like the company's long-term growth prospects, and I'm confident that it will continue to deliver solid returns.

As for any strategic moves, I'm not planning on making any drastic changes to my portfolio right now. I'm staying the course and letting my positions play out. I do think that the market is due for a pullback, but I'm not worried about it. I've got a solid foundation of dividend-paying stocks and ETFs that will help me weather any storms. Looking forward, I'm excited to see how my portfolio will perform over the next few months. Keep in mind that investing always involves some level of risk, but with a solid plan and a bit of patience, I'm confident that I can achieve my long-term goals. Thanks for following along, and I'll catch you all in the next update!
